State-of-the-art facilities spread across 10 acres, providing the ideal environment for academic excellence at AK (PG) College.

1.  Home
2.  About Us
3.  Infrastructure

Campus Overview

AK (PG) College is spread over 10 acres of lush green campus along the banks of the Lower Ganga Canal on Station Road, Shikohabad.
